## What changed or decided
- **`scripts/cca_verdict_usable.py`** (new) — pure `verdict_usability(structured_output) -> (classification, reason)` returning `usable | absent | unparseable | degenerate`. `degenerate` is a present-but-empty `checklist` or `acceptance` (mirroring `enforce_cca_verdict.DEGENERATE_JUDGMENT_ARRAYS`); every real verdict value — `complete` and every negative value alike — is `usable`, so no real answer is ever regenerated (judge-shopping is impossible by accident). A thin `__main__` CLI reads `STRUCTURED_OUTPUT`/stdin and prints `{"classification","reason"}`.
- **`.github/workflows/shiki-cca-completion.yml`** — inserted `Classify CCA output` (id `classify`) between `Run CCA` and `Enforce CCA verdict`, plus `Run CCA (retry)` (id `cca_retry`) guarded by `if: steps.classify.outputs.classification != 'usable'` (identical prompt/schema/allowed tools, no event gate → reachable from both triggers). `Enforce CCA verdict` now selects the retry output only when the first was unusable (`classification == 'usable' && cca || cca_retry`). A still-unusable retry fails the job through the existing enforce checks; the retry decision + first reason are echoed to the job log. Artifact names, evidence manifest, and Guardian blockers step are untouched.
- **`scripts/test_shiki_control_plane.sh`** — asserts the classify step sits between Run CCA and Enforce, the single-retry bound (exactly 2 `claude-code-action@v1` uses; exactly 1 guarded), and that retry is limited to the unusable classes.
- **`tests/test_cca_verdict_usable.py`** (new) — covers absent/whitespace/None, unparseable (non-JSON, truncated, array, scalar), degenerate (empty checklist, empty acceptance, both, PR #233 shape), well-formed `complete` and one case per negative verdict value, purity, the CLI, and full workflow wiring.
- **`scripts/shiki_installer.py`** — added `scripts/cca_verdict_usable.py` to `TEMPLATE_PATHS` so the workflow's dependency ships (required by `test_install_completeness`).
